package fixture

// Data for TestPurityStatelessSelfTest (rule P7: a parser is a stateless value). A type with
// Meta, Probe and Parse methods is a parser; it must be a struct of basic-typed fields only and
// declare its methods on the value. A line that must be flagged ends with the marker "want".

import (
	"context"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

// good: no fields, or basic fields, value receivers
type plain struct{}

func (plain) Meta() int                        { return 0 }
func (plain) Probe(context.Context) error      { return nil }
func (plain) Parse(context.Context) error      { return nil }

type configured struct {
	name  string
	limit int
	ratio float64
	on    bool
	b     byte
	r     rune
	a, c  uint16
}

func (c configured) Meta() int                   { return c.limit }
func (configured) Probe(context.Context) error   { return nil }
func (c configured) Parse(context.Context) error { return nil }

// a method that is not part of the parser contract may have any receiver
func (p *configured) helper() {}

// bad: a pointer receiver on a parser method
type ptrRecv struct{}

func (ptrRecv) Meta() int                   { return 0 }
func (p *ptrRecv) Probe(context.Context) error { return nil } // want
func (ptrRecv) Parse(context.Context) error { return nil }

// bad: fields that can hold state
type withMap struct {
	seen map[string]int // want
}

func (withMap) Meta() int                   { return 0 }
func (withMap) Probe(context.Context) error { return nil }
func (withMap) Parse(context.Context) error { return nil }

type withSlice struct {
	buf []byte // want
}

func (withSlice) Meta() int                   { return 0 }
func (withSlice) Probe(context.Context) error { return nil }
func (withSlice) Parse(context.Context) error { return nil }

type withPointer struct {
	n *int // want
}

func (withPointer) Meta() int                   { return 0 }
func (withPointer) Probe(context.Context) error { return nil }
func (withPointer) Parse(context.Context) error { return nil }

type withNamed struct {
	when time.Time // want
}

func (withNamed) Meta() int                   { return 0 }
func (withNamed) Probe(context.Context) error { return nil }
func (withNamed) Parse(context.Context) error { return nil }

type withEmbedded struct {
	sync.Mutex // want
}

func (*withEmbedded) Meta() int                { return 0 } // want
func (withEmbedded) Probe(context.Context) error { return nil }
func (withEmbedded) Parse(context.Context) error { return nil }

type withArray struct {
	a [4]int // want
}

func (withArray) Meta() int                   { return 0 }
func (withArray) Probe(context.Context) error { return nil }
func (withArray) Parse(context.Context) error { return nil }

type withFunc struct {
	f func() // want
}

func (withFunc) Meta() int                   { return 0 }
func (withFunc) Probe(context.Context) error { return nil }
func (withFunc) Parse(context.Context) error { return nil }

// bad: not a struct at all
type counter int // want

func (counter) Meta() int                   { return 0 }
func (counter) Probe(context.Context) error { return nil }
func (counter) Parse(context.Context) error { return nil }

// not a parser (a method is missing): its fields are not this rule's business
type helperOnly struct {
	cache map[string]int
}

func (helperOnly) Meta() int                   { return 0 }
func (helperOnly) Probe(context.Context) error { return nil }

// bad: redeclaring a predeclared type name would turn a "basic" field into anything
type string map[int]int // want

type int = []byte // want
